Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented Mechanical Analyses Engineer to help us in our mission by contributing to the development, justification and validation of our vehicle. You will work closely with our CAD, thermal and mechanism engineers to optimize together the vehicle mechanical design. You will be part of the Nyx Design Office and will report to the Principal Mechanical Engineer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the mechanical design of primary and secondary structures of the vehicle.

  • Drive mass optimization strategies while maintaining structural integrity and compliance with mission requirements.

  • Design and analyze both metallic and composite structures using advanced materials (e.g., space-graded aluminum alloys, CFRP, honeycomb panels).

  • Define material selection and consider manufacturing constraints in the design.

  • Support the structural development collaborating with external suppliers, from concept to delivery.

  • Develop and manage technical specifications, statements of work, and interface control documents.

  • Ensure supplier designs meet performance, quality, and schedule requirements.

  • Contribute to the overall mechanical architecture of the spacecraft.

  • Ensure proper integration of structural components with other subsystems (thermal, avionics...).

  • Perform or oversee structural analyses (FEA) to validate designs under launch, orbital and reentry environments.

  • Support environmental testing and qualification campaigns.

  • Generate detailed design documentation and verification plans.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant space industry standards (e.g., ECSS, NASA, ISO).

What We Would Love to See from You

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in mechanical design and architecture, preferably in the space or aerospace sector.

  • Strong expertise in composite and or metallic materials and structures sizing.

  • Proficiency in FEA tools (Nastran and Hyperworks).

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

  • Familiarity with manufacturing techniques (e.g., milling, out-of-autoclave curing, ...).

Skills and Behaviors:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly and concisely,

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment,

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done,

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Competence, Integrity and Passion,

data.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a driven, transaction-focused real estate professional to own deal execution across the Central region. You will be part of a lean, high-velocity expansion team reporting directly to the Director of Real Estate, US. This is not a support role. You will run site selection, lead LOI negotiations, manage broker relationships, and drive leases to execution across a growing portfolio of healthcare retail clinics in your markets.

Neko is opening clinics at pace: the US plan moves from a handful of sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens and a portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. Most in-house real estate roles at this scale sit inside large corporate structures where deals move slowly and decisions need layers of approval. Here, your deals matter immediately, your judgment is trusted, and the decisions you make in year one will shape the portfolio for the next decade.

The team is small and growing quickly, built around regional Transaction Leads covering the West, East, and Central United States, supported by national specialists in market analysis, deal support, and lease administration. Many of these seats are still being filled, so you will help set the standard rather than inherit one.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

• Pipeline management: identify, evaluate, and advance sites across Central markets including Texas, Chicago, the Midwest, Nashville, and Denver. Markets are TBD and could extend west or east depending on demand.

• Transaction execution: lead deals from initial market entry through signed lease, managing brokers, landlords, and timelines, at a pace set by the opening plan for the Central region.

• LOI negotiation: draft, negotiate, and revise LOIs; own the deal process end to end from first tour to final execution.

• Deal approval memos: build and present LOI and Lease Approval Memos with clear economics, risks, and a recommendation that stands up to executive scrutiny.

• Landlord relationships: build and maintain relationships with institutional and private landlords across the Central region.

• Broker coordination: manage tenant rep broker relationships across multiple markets simultaneously; hold brokers accountable to pipeline and timeline standards.

• Cross-functional coordination: work closely with Legal, Construction, Design, and Facilities to move deals from signed lease into buildout.

• Platform adoption: use Neko’s GIS site selection platform and lease administration system as the system of record and contribute to their rollout as the function scales.

Minimum Qualifications

• 3 to 7 years of real estate transaction experience, with meaningful time spent in-house at a healthcare, wellness, or high-growth retail company.

• You have personally led deals end to end, from site identification through LOI to signed lease, in competitive markets.

• Comfort working in a startup environment with real pressure, fast timelines, and limited infrastructure. You build as you go.

• A self-starter who does not need a fully defined playbook to do great work.

• Strong communication skills. You can represent Neko professionally with institutional landlords while keeping internal stakeholders informed concisely.

• Ability to read and pressure-test lease terms, rent schedules, and deal economics. You do not need to build financial models from scratch, but you need to know when a deal works and when it does not.

• Familiarity with GIS tools and lease administration platforms is a plus; willingness to learn them quickly is a must.

• AI: We use AI tools including Claude in daily work and expect you to use them too.

• Based in the Central United States. You should be within reasonable travel of the markets you cover.

Compensation: $157.5K – $192.5K

About the role:

At Camunda, our Technical Account Managers (TAMs) are trusted technical advisors, partnering closely with our most strategic customers to help them turn their process orchestration vision into measurable business value. In this highly impactful role, you’ll be “in the boat together” with clients from day one – navigating technical challenges, providing expert guidance, and ensuring smooth adoption of our platform at scale. If you thrive on collaboration, love solving unique challenges, and are excited to empower companies across industries, we want you on our fast-growing, innovative Customer Success team.

  • Guide the creation and execution of tailored technical adoption plans, designed to maximize business outcomes and ensure long-term success

  • Foster strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional Camunda teams such as Customer Success Managers, Consulting, Support, Product, Engineering, Sales and Pre-Sales to drive measurable customer outcomes at scale

  • Demonstrated technical expertise: hands-on with a high-level programming language (such as Java, C#, or Python) and relevant enterprise software frameworks

  • Solid understanding of modern solution architectures and associated paradigms, including DevOps topics (especially Kubernetes)

  • A proven track record of building trusted relationships and providing advisory services to both technical and business stakeholders—able to synthesize and explain complex

  • issues clearly to varied audiences

  • Strategic problem solving competencies with a collaborative, impact-driven mindset; comfortable tailoring approaches to unique customer situations

  • Willingness and flexibility to spend time on-site with clients as account needs dictate (up to 50% during busy periods)

Nice to haves:

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

  • Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations.

  • Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development.

  • Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors.

  • Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.

  • Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability.

  • Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control.

  • Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership.

  • Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists.

  • Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land.

  • Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth.

  • Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy.

What success looks like

First 30 days

  • Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references.

  • Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources.

  • Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

  • Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days

  • Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

  • Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

  • Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

  • Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

  • Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond

  • Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

  • Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

  • Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

  • Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

  • Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

  • Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

  • A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

  • Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately.

  • Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes.

  • A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology.

  • Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners.

  • Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements.

  • Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation.

  • Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction.

Why this role matters now

Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation.

This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands.

You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation.

data.description:
Über uns
Lupa entwickelt ein Produkt, das eine völlig neue Kategorie schafft und das es in der Branche so noch nicht gegeben hat.

Wir sind das KI-native Betriebssystem für Tierarztpraxen und Tierhalter. Unsere intelligente All-in-one-Plattform ersetzt die fragmentierten, umständlichen Systeme, mit denen Tierarztpraxen seit Jahren arbeiten müssen. Sie vereint Terminplanung, Kundenkommunikation, klinische Dokumentation und KI-gestützte Behandlungsempfehlungen. Praxen arbeiten dadurch effizienter, Tierärzte können sich wieder auf das konzentrieren, was sie lieben, und Tierhalter sind enger mit der Gesundheit ihrer Tiere verbunden als je zuvor.

Unsere Erfolge sprechen für sich: 2023 gegründet, sind wir heute Marktführer in Großbritannien, gehören zu den 100 führenden KI-Start-ups Europas und sind in zwölf Monaten um das Zehnfache gewachsen. Unser Team zählt inzwischen 70 Mitarbeitende und wächst schnell weiter. Jetzt expandieren wir mit voller Kraft in die USA und nach Europa. Wir haben 25 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung erhalten, betreuen mehr als 2,5 Millionen Haustiere auf unserer Plattform und haben ein lebendiges Büro in München. Außergewöhnliche Talente von Unternehmen wie Palantir, Google, DeepMind, BCG, Meta und AWS sind bereits Teil unseres Teams, und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

Dies ist die seltene Gelegenheit, genau zum richtigen Zeitpunkt Teil eines rasant wachsenden Unternehmens zu werden. Deshalb suchen wir außergewöhnliche Menschen, die dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

In dieser Rolle wirst du:

  • Die Outbound-Akquise für Tierarztpraxen und Tierkliniken verantworten. Diese Pipeline baust du selbst auf

  • Hochwertige Leads identifizieren, recherchieren und per Kaltakquise über Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn ansprechen

  • Interessenten qualifizieren und Termine für unsere Account Executives vereinbaren, inklusive einer Übergabe mit allem relevanten Kontext

  • Ein tiefes Verständnis für das Produkt, die Kunden und den Markt von Lupa aufbauen, damit deine Ansprache beratend ist und nicht nach Skript klingt

  • Eng mit Marketing und Produkt zusammenarbeiten, um Messaging und Positionierung auf Basis deiner Erfahrungen aus der Praxis zu schärfen

  • Die Pipelinedaten im CRM korrekt und aktuell halten, denn unser Team arbeitet mit sauberen Daten

  • Erkenntnisse aus deinen Gesprächen mit Interessenten an das Team weitergeben und so unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie und Produktentwicklung mitgestalten

Dein Hintergrund könnte wie folgt aussehen:

  • Fundierte Vertriebserfahrung als SDR, BDR oder in einer anderen Outbound-Rolle. Erfahrung in B2B SaaS oder Tech ist von Vorteil, aber auch andere Branchen sind willkommen!

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Muss

  • Bereitschaft, vor Ort in unserem Büro in München zu arbeiten

  • Du bist sicher in der Akquise per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und gehst dabei beratend vor

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst den Mehrwert eines Produkts klar vermitteln, sowohl gegenüber medizinischem Fachpersonal als auch gegenüber nicht technischen Ansprechpartnern

  • Sehr gute Organisation und hohe Eigenmotivation: Du behältst mehrere Interessenten und Pipelines gleichzeitig im Blick, ohne an Schwung zu verlieren

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM und ein datengetriebener Ansatz zur Verbesserung deiner Outreach-Ergebnisse sind von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Vertical SaaS oder im Umfeld professioneller Dienstleistungen ist von Vorteil

Als Person:

  • Interessierst du dich ehrlich für die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und willst sie lösen, anstatt nur eine Anrufquote zu erfüllen

  • Bist du hungrig auf Wachstum und bereit, alles für deinen Erfolg zu geben

  • Bist du belastbar: Absagen bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe, sie machen dich besser

  • Möchtest du dich in eine Closing-Rolle entwickeln und siehst die SDR-Position als Sprungbrett, nicht als Endstation

  • Freust du dich darauf, vor Ort in unserem Büro in München zu arbeiten, mit gelegentlichen Reisen zu unserem Hauptsitz in London

  • Arbeitest du gerne mit Menschen, die freundlich, ambitioniert und pragmatisch sind

  • Liebst du Tiere? Das ist ein Bonus, denn du verkaufst an Menschen, die ihr Berufsleben den Tieren gewidmet haben

Wie sieht Erfolg nach sechs Monaten aus?

  • Du vereinbarst kontinuierlich qualifizierte Termine, und deine Pipeline ist eine, mit der unsere Account Executives wirklich gerne arbeiten

  • Du kennst Produkt, Markt und Kunden so gut, dass du Discovery Calls eigenständig führen kannst

  • Du prägst bereits, wie das Team über Outbound denkt. Deine Erkenntnisse aus der Praxis verändern, wie wir in den Markt gehen

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for a Senior Seeker Systems Engineer (EO/IR & Radar) to define and develop the sensing capabilities of our next-generation autonomous systems. You will lead the selection, integration, and optimization of onboard sensors, including daylight cameras, thermal imagers, radar, and other targeting payloads, ensuring reliable target detection, tracking, and engagement.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

  1. Lead new EO/IR sensor designs in collaboration with hardware and systems engineering teams.

  2. Evaluate and select EO, IR, radar, laser, and multi-sensor solutions.

  3. Develop sensor fusion, target detection, tracking, and classification algorithms.

  4. Specify sensor performance requirements, including range, field of view, stabilization, and SWaP constraints.

  5. Drive integration of sensors into gimbals, payloads, and autonomy systems.

  6. Conduct trade studies, system performance analyses, and supplier evaluations.

  7. Support in ground testing, validation, and flight trials.


  1. Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Mechatronics, or similar.

  2. Experience in missile seekers, guided weapons, EO/IR payloads, targeting systems, gimbals, ISR sensors, or defense electronics.

  3. Strong knowledge of:

    • Electro-optical (EO) cameras

    • Thermal / IR imaging systems

    • Radar and RF sensing

    • Sensor fusion and target tracking

  4. Experience translating mission requirements into sensor architectures and payload designs.

  5. Hands-on mindset with the ability to take ownership of critical technical decisions.

Ideal Candidate?

You have worked on missile programs, loitering munitions, ISR payloads, targeting systems, or stabilized gimbals and understand how to answer key questions such as:

  • What sensor suite is required for the mission?

  • EO, thermal, radar, or multi-mode seeker?

  • How should sensors be integrated into the autonomy stack?

  • How can detection performance be maximized within strict size, weight, and power constraints?

You'll play a key role in shaping the sensing and targeting capabilities of our next-generation autonomous systems.

Why TYTAN?

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

About the Role

As our Senior Partner Manager DACH, you'll own and grow Tellent's partner ecosystem across the DACH market. You'll inherit an established network of reseller and referral partners, including a group of key strategic partners with significant growth potential — and your role is to turn that foundation into a stronger, more predictable source of pipeline and revenue.

You'll build trusted relationships with key partners, create joint growth plans, identify whitespace opportunities across their customer base, and hold partners accountable for execution. At the same time, you'll identify and recruit new high-potential partners, particularly within the HR ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll operate with significant ownership, treating the DACH partner business almost like your own business and bringing a clear point of view on where the market can grow.

You will report to the VP Partnerships.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You build a strong understanding of the DACH partner ecosystem, establish relationships with key partners and Sales stakeholders, and define a clear plan for where to focus your time and investment.

  • Within 6 months: You're independently managing the partner portfolio, driving joint business plans with key partners, generating quality pipeline, and identifying new partner opportunities.

  • After 1 year: You're driving predictable partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across DACH, growing the strategic partner portfolio, and expanding the ecosystem with new partners that contribute meaningful business.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Partner Management: Own and grow Tellent's most impactful DACH partner relationships, building long-term relationships and joint business plans focused on mutual growth.

  • Partner Performance: Monitor partner health, pipeline and revenue performance, identify risks early, and hold partners accountable to agreed activities and results.

  • Commercial Growth: Generate partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, improve opportunity quality and conversion, and ensure strong collaboration with Sales throughout the deal cycle.

  • Account & Whitespace Planning: Work side by side with strategic partners to analyse their customer base, identify whitespace opportunities and build plans to generate new business together.

  • Partner Acquisition: Identify, qualify and recruit high-potential new partners, particularly across the HR ecosystem, assessing them based on strategic fit and revenue potential.

  • Activation & Enablement: Ensure new and existing partners are effectively enabled on Tellent, our products, ICP and sales approach, and turn partnerships into active commercial relationships.

  • Market Development: Bring a strong point of view on the DACH market, identifying opportunities beyond the existing partner ecosystem and translating ideas into concrete execution.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, particularly the DACH Sales team, as well as Marketing and other Partnerships colleagues to improve deal execution, campaigns, enablement and pipeline quality.

  • Operational Excellence: Identify recurring friction in the partner GTM motion and contribute to improving playbooks, cadences, partner planning and ways of working across the wider Partnerships team.

What You Bring

  • Partnership Experience: Several years of experience in a partner, channel or business development role, with a proven track record of building and growing strategic partner relationships.

  • DACH Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the German market and ideally an established network of relevant DACH partners.

  • SaaS Experience: Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within HR tech or an adjacent mid-market/SMB environment.

  • Commercial Skill: Strong understanding of pipeline generation, forecasting, partner planning and commercial performance, with experience in reseller and/or referral models.

  • Strategic Thinking: Able to assess a partner portfolio, identify where the biggest opportunities are, and make clear decisions about where to invest time and resources.

  • Execution: You don't just have ideas — you turn them into structured plans, actions and measurable results.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take ownership of the DACH partner business as if it were your own, proactively looking for opportunities and challenging existing assumptions.

  • Relationship Building: Strong at building trusted relationships while also being comfortable setting expectations, challenging partners and addressing underperformance.

  • Self-Management: Highly organised and able to manage a broad portfolio, prioritising time effectively across partners, Sales and new opportunities.

  • Communication: Professional fluency in German and English, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and operating across cross-functional teams.

  • Travel: Comfortable travelling regularly across Germany to build and maintain strong in-person partner relationships.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working in the Cologne area as we continue building our local team presence

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget

  • Pension scheme & wellness/fitness benefits

  • Country-specific holiday policies apply

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • Home office budget and allowance

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

AI in our recruitment process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at 

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

As a leading global software product company in the field of Compliance & Automation, ITMF Group develop cutting-edge RegTech solutions with a focus on Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Fraud. We value innovation, excellence, and continuous learning at IMTF Group. We provide a dynamic, collaborative work environment where your ideas will be heard, and your skills will be put to the test.  

As a Working Student, you will support our Pre-Sales team in preparing presentations, demos and proposals that showcase the value of our compliance solutions to potential clients.

 

Responsibilities

  • Support the Pre-Sales team in preparing product presentations and demonstrations, e.g. slides, demo scenarios and test data
  • Assist in responding to requests for information (RFIs) and requests for proposals (RFPs) by researching information, compiling answers and maintaining our response library
  • Help keep our demo environments up-to-date, including creating test data and checking new product features after releases
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, training materials and presentation templates
  • Support proof of concept projects, e.g. with data preparation and documentation of results
  • Conduct market and competitor research in the field of RegTech, Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Fraud
  • Document customer feedback and prepare it for the product development team

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s program in Business Informatics, Business Administration with a focus on Finance/Banking, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Interest in software and technology; interest in the financial sector or compliance topics is a plus
  • Structured and accurate way of working, with the ability to quickly familiarize yourself with complex topics
  • Confident use of MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude
  • Good communication skills, team spirit and a proactive attitude
  • First practical experience from an internship or student job is an advantage, but not a must
  • Fluent in both German and English, both written and spoken; additional languages are a plus

Benefits

  • Make the World Safer: Contribute to preventing financial crime and help our customers create a safer world.
  • Be Part of an Established RegTech: Make a difference at a leading RegTech company in Switzerland.
  • International Exposure: Expand your horizons by working with international customers on various challenging projects and markets in a dynamic, multicultural team.
  • Ownership and Development: Make an impact and develop yourself by taking on significant ownership and responsibility from the beginning.
  • Paid Further Education: Take advantage of opportunities for paid further education to enhance your skills and career growth.

 

The anticipated salary for a Working Student – Pre Sales Support in Bensheim, Germany is EUR 18.000 gross per year based on a 20 hours working week (50 % employment level). 

At IMTF, we are committed to treating all candidates with respect and equality, regardless of gender, religion, nationality, or any other characteristic. We embrace diversity and inclusion as integral components of our organizational culture, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply and contribute to our team.

We build software that helps companies along the food system get to Net Zero.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Enterprise software and new business processes can help.

We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀

🔭 What this freelance role looks like

This is not a full- or part-time position. We're looking for a freelancer to support our Slovenian-speaking customers on a project basis. After an initial onboarding phase, you will take on assignments as needed, primarily running virtual trainings and supporting customers through key phases of our platform.

Expect low and irregular hours — this role suits someone who has other engagements and is looking for flexible, project-based work in the sustainability space.

Your assignments will typically include:

🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware

Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence.

Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads.

 

About the Role

As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer, you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy.

This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team.

The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system.

  • Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows.

  • Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized.

  • Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system.

  • Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable.

  • Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab.

     
 

Your Profile

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches.

  • You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field.

  • You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems.

  • You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines.

  • You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage.

  • You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe.

  • You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

     
 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination.

  • Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors

  • Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation.

  • Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field.

  • Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy.

  • Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures.

  • Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows.

  • Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you. We are an AI-first company empowering every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge.

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Technical Screen (30 min): First overview of your abilities in system integration, field testing and debugging

  3. Technical Interview (45 min): We dive deeper into your hardware design skills and ability to iterate based on first principle reasoning.

  4. Onsite Trial/Case (1.5-2 hrs): We’ll integrate, diagnose, debug, or test something together, just like on the job.

  5. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides

data.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.

As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

Core Responsibilities
  • Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better.
  • Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter.
  • Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and solve their problems.
  • Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves.
  • Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge.
  • Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers.

    • What We Value
  • Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science.
  • A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.
  • Experience or interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems.
  • Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.
  • Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision.
  • Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but may vary by team and location.

    • What We Require
  • Fluency in German
  • Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance.
    • Life at Palantir
     
    We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
     
    In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
     
    If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please and let us know how we can help.
     
    Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. While we have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe, this particular role is based on-site in Sunnyvale. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Location: This is an on-site role based in Sunnyvale, CA (required), with flexible office hours.

Responsibilities

The role will require you to join Tensordyne's Platform Software team to lead requirements gathering, design, and development of system-level services, tools, and supporting tests for Tensordyne's AI inference platform software, including debugging, profiling, and analysis capabilities. The successful candidate will support cross-functional engineering teams in the bring-up and validation of platform software on AI inference systems, and partner closely with the hardware, silicon, and validation teams to deliver robust, production-quality platform software. You will work close to the hardware on firmware and board bring-up, bootloaders and BSP development, device drivers, and Linux kernel modules, collaborating directly with the silicon and hardware teams on hardware/software co-design. The role also involves system-level performance and power optimization across the AI inference platform, working with low-level interfaces such as PCIe, I2C, SPI, and JTAG. Occasional travel (e.g., to partner, customer, or contract manufacturer sites) may be required but is not mandatory.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience developing low-level systems and embedded software, firmware, and tooling for high-performance computing systems deployed to data center customers.
  • Hands-on experience bringing up and debugging complex Linux-based systems at the kernel and driver level, including embedded Linux, device drivers, and/or RTOS environments; experience with SoC/silicon bring-up is highly desirable. Familiarity with AI inference frameworks and data center deployment/management environments is preferred.
  • Expert programming experience in C and C++, with proficiency in Python, Bash/Shell, and/or related programming languages. Rust experience is a plus. Comfortable interfacing directly with hardware, reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging with tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across hardware, silicon, and software teams in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts and practical solutions.
  • BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem’s AI-powered MRI systems run on edge infrastructure deployed directly at customer sites, such as hatcheries and food processing plants. As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, availability, and performance of this growing global fleet.

You are the team’s deepest technical authority on the on-premise platform, setting architecture and standards through hands-on expertise. You will own the hardware, network, operating system, and Kubernetes layers that power teams like Data, Machine Learning, and Software.

Your Day-to-Day

As an Individual Contributor on the expert track, your responsibilities center entirely on deep technical ownership and execution:

Edge Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own the reliability and lifecycle of our edge racks: server hardware, network equipment, custom Linux-based OS, and the GPU-enabled Kubernetes layer running our AI classification services.

  • Design and improve automation for provisioning our growing fleet (50+ edge clusters and counting) using tools like Terraform, BMC/IPMI, and router APIs.

  • Maintain the secure network connecting edge deployments to our central cloud, and the tooling that enables safe software delivery to the fleet.

Reliability & Incident Management

  • Participate in the rotation of support on weekdays and own triage and resolution for escalated production issues.

  • Lead post-incident reviews and turn findings into lasting, automated fixes.

  • Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs/SLAs for physical edge systems running unattended in the field.

  • Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, custom hardware exporters, Grafana, Datadog) to catch issues proactively, often before customers notice.

Architecture, Collaboration & Craft

  • Set technical direction for edge infrastructure projects and contribute to technical planning and ticket writing.

  • Mentor fellow engineers through pairing, design/code reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar without formal management authority.

  • Act as the top-level technical escalation point, personally helping resolve the most complex support and production issues.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (with the eventual support of a Product Manager) to gather requirements and manage technical alignment.

Behavioral competencies

  • Strategic Thinker: You develop a clear vision and roadmap for the edge platform, considering its long-term health, scalability, and usability.

  • Strong Communicator: You build strong relationships with development teams and other stakeholders, communicate changes clearly, and secure buy-in.

  • High Ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of your technical output, including reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement.

  • Data-Driven: You use metrics on uptime, incidents, and support requests to prioritize the work that delivers the most value.

  • Customer-Focused: You keep developer and end-customer experience front of mind in your planning and execution.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team and own the internal, backend-heavy products behind our operations.

Every item rebuy sells has been through our hands. Before a pre-owned book, DVD, or game reaches a customer, it has been bought in, received, identified, tested, graded, stored, picked, packed, and shipped. The systems that run this flow are the focus of this team, and the users are the hundreds of colleagues in our operations teams.


You will own the tools and services behind inbound processing, grading and quality control, fulfillment, and returns. Your users are warehouse operators, graders, pickers, and operations leads. Your customers are, in the end, every rebuy buyer and seller who relies on the condition and delivery promise we make.

For this role we need someone who is genuinely detail-oriented, who reads the data before forming an opinion, who understands systems and data flows end-to-end, and who can translate operational reality into precise requirements and measurable outcomes.

As a Product Manager you work hand in hand with operations leadership, team leads, engineering, and data to deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. You will spend time on the floor with the people who use your products, translate their goals and constraints into a roadmap you own, build the business case with unit economics together with operations and finance, and negotiate scope and timing with engineering. Improvements are co-created with the people who run the operation, not handed to them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive domain product roadmap: Translate ops strategy (throughput, unit cost, quality, lead time) into a 6–12 month roadmap with the Strategy Manager and Ops Product Lead. Make and document trade-off decisions with ops leaders

  • Understand operational reality: Spend time at the warehouse mapping processes and data flows end-to-end to uncover system gaps and unmet needs early

  • Drive data-backed decisions: Analyze KPIs, pull data, avoid measurement traps, and connect feature changes to unit economics improvements

  • Write precise requirements: Specify business rules, edge cases, data models, state transitions, integrations, and failure modes for engineering

  • Ship iteratively without disruption: Sequence releases safely using pilots, feature flags, parallel runs, change management, and pre-defined metrics

  • Collaborate across teams: Engage in technical discussions and manage scope, time, and urgency trade-offs with tech and ops leads

  • Build stakeholder buy-in: Align ops, CS, tech, finance, and leadership on shared metrics via clear written communication


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on backend, internal, workflow, or operational products (for example warehouse, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, order management, inventory, marketplace operations, fintech back-office, or similar)

  • Hands-on data skills: you can work fluently in an analytics environment, build your own analyses, define metrics rigorously, and spot when a number is misleading

  • Strong attention to detail: experience writing precise specifications covering business rules, edge cases, data models, and failure modes, and catching problems before they reach production

Why This Role Matters

As a Senior Business Transformation Analyst - Quality Management, you will play a key role in shaping and harmonizing quality processes across Intersnack's international manufacturing entities. Acting as the bridge between Quality, Operations, and IT, you will drive business transformation initiatives with a strong focus on ERP implementations, system rollouts, and process standardization from the Quality perspective.

This role is ideal for someone who combines deep expertise in Food Quality Management, Food Safety, and Manufacturing with proven experience supporting large-scale ERP transformation programs. You will help ensure that quality processes, data, and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into future ways of working across our global organization.

Your Role at Intersnack

  • Own quality-related workstreams within large-scale business transformation and ERP implementation programs.

  • Act as the Quality subject matter expert during ERP design data migration, owning your workstream, process validation, System integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT) post-go-live support activities and training activities from a Quality Management perspective.

  • Drive the harmonization and standardization of quality processes across multiple countries and business units.

  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications and collaborate closely with IT, external partners, and implementation teams.

  • Identify opportunities to improve quality processes, governance, compliance, and reporting capabilities.

  • Facilitate workshops with quality, production, supply chain, R&D, and commercial stakeholders.

  • Ensure alignment between business requirements, regulatory standards, and system capabilities.

  • Partner with local and regional teams to drive adoption of new processes and tools.

  • Support change management activities and promote best practices across the organization.

  • Represent Business Transformation in discussions with Management Units, Group Functions, and external implementation partners.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration and influence stakeholders across all organizational levels.


Your profile

  • University degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Quality Management, Engineering or a related discipline.

  • At least 3 to 5 years of professional experience within Food Quality Management, Quality Assurance, Food Safety, or Food Manufacturing environments, FMCG or Food & Beverages.

  • Proven track record in ERP implementation Infor M3, SAP, Oracle or similar ERP solutions.

  • Solid Working knowledge of HACCP and at least one GFSI-recognized standard (e.g. BRCGS, IFS, FSSC 22000).

  • Strong understanding of quality processes across manufacturing environments.

  • Experience translating business requirements into functional specifications and process designs.

  • Willingness to travel approximately 4 days per week across Intersnack locations during project phases and rollouts.

What Makes You Successful

  • You build trust quickly with local teams, because adoption happens at the plants, not in the design workshop.

Working with us 

Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world.

Successful and sustainably growing, we generated sales of more than 4.6 billion euros in 2025. We now have 12 regional Management Units with more than 40 production sites in Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand and a total workforce of more than 15,000 people.

What we will offer

An enjoyable, broad and fulfilling role with one of Europe’s biggest savory snacks producers. The chance to grow in an environment that values teamwork and collaboration, as well recognized to your individuality, welcoming your views, and celebrating your growth. Werde Teil unseres Teams 

Apaleo ist die offene Hospitality-Plattform, die Hotels die Freiheit gibt, ihre Technologie so zusammenzustellen, wie sie sie wirklich brauchen. Wir waren von Anfang an API-first, und jetzt denken wir unsere Plattform AI-first weiter: Mit Agent Hub, dem ersten KI-Agenten-Marktplatz der Hotellerie, geben wir Hotels die Freiheit, autonome Agenten für ihr Business einzusetzen. Denselben Anspruch haben wir an unser eigenes Finance: Wir bauen es konsequent AI-native auf. 

Dafür suchen wir eine*n Senior Bilanzbuchhalter*in, die oder der fundiertes Buchhaltungs-Know-how mit echter Begeisterung für agentische Workflows verbindet und mit uns Strukturen, Prozesse und Kontrollen für ein skalierbares Finance aufbaut. Du übernimmst zunächst eigenverantwortlich das operative Tagesgeschäft in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem dreiköpfigen Finance-Team. Mittelfristig verschiebt sich dein Fokus vom Buchen zum Orchestrieren: KI-Agenten übernehmen Belegverarbeitung, Kontierung und Abstimmungen, du definierst die Regeln, überwachst die Ergebnisse und verantwortest Qualität und Compliance als Human in the Loop. Mittelfristig gestaltest du mit uns den Weg zu einem AI-native Accounting- und ERP-Setup und wirst zur zentralen Ansprechperson für alle buchhalterischen Fragen bei Apaleo. 

So bringst du dich ein:

  • Du bearbeitest eigenverantwortlich sämtliche in der Finanzbuchhaltung anfallenden Geschäftsvorfälle (Rechnungskontrolle, Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen-, Sachkonten- und Bankbuchhaltung) und stellst eine jederzeit prüfungssichere, GoBD-konforme Datenbasis für Reporting und Steuerung sicher.  
  • Du übernimmst zusammen mit unserem Team die Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit festen Deadlines und treibst einen schnelleren, zunehmend automatisierten Close (Fast Close) voran.  
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst agentische Workflows für wiederkehrende Prozesse wie Belegerfassung, Kontierung, Bankabstimmung, Rückstellungen und Intercompany und gestaltest damit, wie sich deine eigene Rolle über die Zeit entwickelt: weg vom manuellen Buchen, hin zum Orchestrieren, Überwachen und Freigeben der Arbeit von KI-Agenten. 
  • Du arbeitest eng mit externen Steuerberater*innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen zusammen.  
  • Du gestaltest mit, wie sich unser Finance-Tech-Stack mittelfristig zu einem AI-native Accounting- und ERP-Setup entwickelt: von Tool-Auswahl und Datenmodell über saubere Stammdaten und Schnittstellen bis zu skalierbaren End-to-End-Prozessen, die mit uns mitwachsen.  
  • Du wirst über Zeit zur zentralen Ansprechperson für alle buchhalterischen Fragen bei Apaleo und bringst die Erfahrung und Übersicht mit, um Themen auch über dein eigenes Gebiet hinaus einzuordnen. 

Das bringst du mit:

Must-haves 

  • Abgeschlossene Aus-/Weiterbildung zum/zur Bilanzbuchhalter*in (IHK) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, mit mehrjähriger praktischer Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung.  
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im deutschen Handelsrecht (HGB); IFRS-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.  
  • Sehr gute DATEV- und Excel-Kenntnisse sowie ein ausgeprägtes Prozess- und Systemverständnis: Du denkst in Datenflüssen, nicht in Einzelbuchungen.  
  • Erfahrung mit Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen unter echtem Zeit- und Deadlinedruck im Unternehmen. 
  • Nahezu muttersprachliches Deutsch (für die Kommunikation mit Steuerberater*innen, Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen und Behörden sowie für statutarische Meldungen) und gutes Arbeitsenglisch (für die Zusammenarbeit mit Legal und weiteren internationalen Stakeholdern).  
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, du sprichst Unklarheiten direkt an, statt sie auflaufen zu lassen.  
  • Du bist mindestens zweimal pro Woche in unserem Büro in München, idealerweise wohnst du bereits in München oder im Umkreis.  
  • Du bist komfortabel mit Prozessambiguität und schnellem Wandel, triffst pragmatische 80/20-Entscheidungen und lieferst gleichzeitig hohe Qualität, wo es darauf ankommt. 
  • Echte Neugier auf KI: Du nutzt Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude bereits im Arbeitsalltag, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und willst Prozesse grundlegend neu denken, statt sie nur zu digitalisieren. 

Nice-to-haves 

  • Du hast bereits agentische Workflows oder Automatisierungen im Finanzbereich aufgesetzt (z. B. mit LLMs, RPA oder Tools wie n8n oder Make) und kannst konkret zeigen, wie sich dadurch Qualität, Durchlaufzeit und Close verbessert haben.  
  • Erfahrung in einem Software-/SaaS-Unternehmen oder einem wachstumsstarken Start-up/Scale-up; Vertrautheit mit SaaS-Kennzahlen.  
  • Erfahrung in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld.  
  • Berührungspunkte mit Verrechnungspreisthemen (Transfer Pricing).  
  • Vertrautheit mit Employer-of-Record-Strukturen (EOR) und ihren

Das kannst du von uns erwarten:

  • Ein vielfältiges und internationales Team – Arbeite mit engagierten Experten aus verschiedenen Fachbereichen und mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund zusammen und entwickele eine wirklich globale Lösung.
  • Flache Hierarchie und flexible Struktur – Genieße Autonomie und Eigenverantwortung in einem Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit mehr geschätzt wird als starre Hierarchien.
  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen – Werde Teil eines der vielversprechendsten internationalen Software Unternehmens der Hotellerie im Herzen Münchens und gestalte den Finanzbereich aktiv mit.
  • Faire und transparente Vergütung – Profitiere von einem klaren Peer-Review-System und einem Career Progression Plänen, der Ihr Wachstum unterstützen.
  • Ein AI-native Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite mit aktuellen KI-Tools und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum, um Finance von Grund auf neu zu denken.  
  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit Teamtagen in München: Mindestens zweimal pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Münchner Büro, den Rest der Woche gestaltest du flexibel.  
  • Ansprechende Team-Events – Nimm an unseren Teamessen, Meet-ups und den legendären Partys teil.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub – Tanke neue Energie und genieße eine großzügige Urlaubsregelung.
  • Kostenlose Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel in Deutschland – Mit dem Deutschlandticket Job bist du bestens versorgt.
  • Zugang zu EGYM Wellness Pass – Nutze eine Vielzahl von Fitness- und Wellnessstudios, um dein körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden zu fördern.

Bereit, mit uns durchzustarten?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Du kannst Dich direkt über unsere Karriereseite mit Deinem Lebenslauf bewerben.

Warum Apaleo?

Bei Apaleo zu arbeiten bedeutet mehr als nur eine Stelle anzutreten: Es geht darum, echte Veränderungen in der Hotellerie voranzutreiben. Deine Beiträge gestalten unsere innovative, API-first und zunehmend AI-first Plattform direkt mit, beeinflussen unternehmensweite Entscheidungen und helfen, die Zukunft der Hospitality-Technologie neu zu definieren. Bei Apaleo zählt deine Meinung, deine Ideen werden geschätzt, und dein Einfluss ist spürbar. Werde Teil eines Teams, in dem deine Arbeit den Fortschritt vorantreibt, Zusammenarbeit Innovationen hervorbringt und Wachstum ein gemeinsames Ziel ist.

data.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Most sales roles hand you a territory, a playbook and a quota. This one hands you a market that does not exist yet. We are looking for a builder: someone who would rather create a market than inherit one. Our first enterprise customers are live and the signal is clear. Everything after that is yours to build.

Putting physical AI onto a production line is not a software sale. It reaches the plant manager, the COO, the works council, safety and compliance, IT, procurement, and often the CEO. Deals take time, run through site visits and technical assessments, and are won on trust. Your job is to close our first deals in DACH and turn them into a market we own.

 

We look for ownership, high agency and low ego, someone who wants to shape both our customer base, shape how we sell and succeed.

What You Will Do

  • Close our first enterprise deals in DACH. Own each one end to end, from first conversation to signed contract.

  • Run the full cycle: discovery, NDAs, use cases and footage, site visits, and a technical deployment assessment covering hardware, data, investment and timeline.

  • Seek the truth on every deal. Find out what Atlas can and cannot do on each customer’s line, say it plainly, and never sell what we cannot deliver, even when it costs the deal.

  • Navigate the whole buying group: plant managers, COOs, works councils, safety and compliance, procurement, and the board. Bring each of them along.

  • Build your own pipeline. Find the industrial champions in your market and get in the room.

  • Develop the playbook as you go: who we sell to, how we price, what wins and what does not. The next ten sellers will run on what you build.

  • Take what you learn on the floor back to product, research and deployment.

Requirements

  • A track record of building, wherever you earned it: a market, a team, a company, a product line. Something that exists because you made it.

  • Enterprise sales experience. You have closed long, complex deals with many stakeholders, and you know how to keep them moving when they stall.

  • At your best in ambiguity. No map, no precedent, no one to ask.

  • You sell a vision and people trust you with it. Honest, likeable, low ego, high standards.

  • Willing to get your hands dirty. You build the account lists, write the proposals, and go to site yourself.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Based in Munich, in the office, with regular travel to customer sites.

Nice to Have

  • You have sold to operations buyers: plant or site managers, COOs, heads of manufacturing or logistics.

  • You have run pilots, POCs, or hardware-plus-software deals.

  • You have been early somewhere: founding AE, first sales hire, or early Head of Sales.

  • A background in operations consulting, VC, or as a founder.

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.
