Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer – Paris/Grenoble

About Vinci

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy and determinism of traditional simulation and the speed and scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world's most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market, and integrated into complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European technical sales team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci's platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating the transformative value of our software.

By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition, showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges, including both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci's capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci's technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline, and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, and partner directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci's differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermal management and cooling solutions, either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial track record: Direct experience commercializing technical software, ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools, into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-to-market experience: Prior experience within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging tech adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Don't just use AI; help redefine how next-generation hardware is designed.

  • Work at the convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

 
 

À propos de Vinci

Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés et mis en production.

 

Présentation du poste

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l’adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d’ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d’accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d’améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la physique thermique et des stratégies de refroidissement, vous guiderez l’analyse de systèmes complexes de gestion thermique, notamment les phénomènes de transfert de chaleur, d’écoulement des fluides et de dissipation thermique, en régime permanent comme transitoire. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que les risques thermiques, la fiabilité des composants, la densité de puissance et l’efficacité des solutions de refroidissement, afin de concevoir des systèmes de gestion thermique performants pour les équipements de nouvelle génération.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d’usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d’interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l’équipe américaine

 

Responsabilités

  • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d’ingénieur·es thermiques, en définissant l’orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l’équipe, et en pilotant l’exécution sur le terrain à travers l’Europe.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

  • Accompagner les équipes d’ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d’évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l’exécution de cas de test complexes et l’interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

  • Piloter l’accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l’onboarding, le déploiement et l’expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

  • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

  • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d’événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

  • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+ ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en gestion thermique et solutions de refroidissement — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique.

Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies.

Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client.

🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

You will coordinate the operations of Resilience-sponsored and investigator-initiated studies across several therapeutic areas. About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

  • Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

  • Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

  • Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

     
 

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

  • Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

  • Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

  • Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

  • Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

 

Example Projects

  • Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

  • Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

  • Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

 

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

 

About Linkup

 

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Marketing Team

Marketing at Pelico is a growth function, not a support function. We work hand-in-hand with Sales and BDRs to create qualified pipeline with the largest industrial companies in the world. Our audience is senior: COOs, VPs of Operations, supply chain, and manufacturing leaders at enterprise accounts.

Events are one of our strongest levers for reaching them: trade shows, executive dinners, roundtables, webinars, and Pelico-hosted events in Europe and the US—occasionally co-hosted with partners and industry bodies, which means co-building the format, splitting the cost, and sharing the audience. We measure ourselves on meetings and pipeline, not on badge scans.

Your Mission

You'll own Pelico's event growth engine end-to-end, turning field events into a measurable, efficient source of qualified pipeline and customer engagement.

  • Decide what we do and what we stop: You own the portfolio—which events we commit to, which we drop, and which formats get more budget next year. This is the heart of the role.

  • Own the event portfolio from strategy and prioritization through delivery, follow-up, and post-event review: That covers trade shows, webinars, executive dinners, roundtables, as well as Pelico-hosted, customer, and partner events.

  • Tie every event to a commercial outcome: For each event, you'll define the target accounts and audiences, the meeting and pipeline goals, and the metrics that matter.

  • Run delivery and budget with discipline: You'll set clear timelines, owners, and vendor plans, keeping spend under control across many activities at once.

  • Get Sales and BDRs committed: No event goes ahead without Sales ownership, a prospecting plan, pre-booked meetings, and a named follow-up owner.

  • Make results visible: You'll set up reliable lead capture and HubSpot tracking so leads, meetings, opportunities, and costs can be tracked for every event.

  • Turn events into content: Speaker and customer interviews, event films, social coverage, and approvals with appearing customers—coordinated with team members who produce it.

We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. What We Offer:

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.


What you will do

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

  • Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

  • ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.

  • Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

    •  

    Technical Customization & Custom Development

  • Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

  • Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

  • Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.

    •  

    API & Ecosystem Integrations

  • Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

  • Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.

  • Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

    •  

    Platform Operations & System Health

  • Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

  • Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

  • Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Core Technical Competencies

  • Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

  • Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

  • Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

  • MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

    •  

    Experience

  • 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

  • Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

  • Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.

    •  

    Key Personality Traits

  • Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.

  • Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.

  • Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position:

Sonar is looking for an Inside Sales Executive to join a Major Accounts pod and support two Major Account Managers in covering a portfolio of key accounts end to end. You will help the pod reach complete coverage of each account by prospecting into entities that are not yet customers and supporting entities that already run Sonar instances. You will own the full sales cycle on the opportunities you source: qualification, proof of concept, business case, negotiation with procurement and close.


On a daily basis, you will

  • Partner with two Major Account Managers in a pod model to build and execute account plans that give full coverage of key accounts and their business units

  • Generate new leads and opportunities in entities of key accounts that are not yet Sonar customers, using a multi-channel approach (LinkedIn, email, video, cold calls and meetings) to convert identified prospects into new logos

  • Engage and grow entities that already run Sonar instances, identifying new teams, use cases, products and editions

  • Run discovery calls and demos, and guide prospects through proofs of concept and trials with Solutions Engineers, validating Sonar's value against agreed success criteria

  • Support Marketing with account-based, customer-focused campaigns, and work with SDRs, Customer Success and Sales Operations to hand over smoothly after the sale

  • Meet or exceed quarterly and yearly targets for pipeline creation and bookings

  • Share customer and competitive insights, and proactively build, grow and share sales team best practices

  • Have 2 to 5 years of experience in a B2B sales role (Inside Sales, SDR/BDR moving into an AE role, Account Executive or Account Manager), ideally in a SaaS or subscription model

  • Have a proven track record of creating pipeline and closing deals, with exposure to the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation

  • Know a structured qualification methodology such as BANT and MEDDPICC, and apply it consistently to understand customer needs, pains and decision processes

  • Have experience selling a technical product to a technical buyer, as well as to business stakeholders such as security teams and procurement

  • Have proven prospecting skills across channels and tools such as Outreach, ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn, calling and networking

  • Be familiar with selling to and negotiating with mid-market and enterprise customers, including deals above 20k USD

  • Communicate confidently with executive-level contacts and tailor value messages to the persona, with both bottom-up and top-down approaches

  • Be comfortable running discovery calls, demos and technical evaluations or POCs alongside a Solutions Engineer

  • Be able to negotiate commercial terms and navigate procurement, legal and security reviews through to signature

  • Have Salesforce expertise and be highly organized: manage many accounts and opportunities in parallel, with accurate CRM hygiene and forecasting

  • Be customer-centric: we want happy customers

  • Show strong communication and listening skills, handle objections well, and welcome feedback and coaching

  • Be a self-driven, proactive and hungry team player who works well in a pod structure with senior Account Managers and cares about team and company goals

  • Have experience selling software development tooling or selling into the development side of IT, and closing deals internationally (a plus)

  • Be curious about how AI-assisted development changes code quality and security

Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen.

Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht.

Über Dukers

Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen.

Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen.

Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson.

  • Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online.

  • Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig.

  • Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit.

  • Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt.

Womit du arbeitest

  • Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure

  • Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox

  • Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba

  • Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco

  • Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben

  • Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender

  • Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort

  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt.

Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze

Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung.

Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan.

Was dich bei Dukers erwartet

  • Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest.

  • Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv.

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn.

  • Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen.

  • Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit.

  • E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation.

  • Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung.

Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Wer eine Umgebung betreut, kennt sie am besten – also liegt die Entscheidung dort, wo das Wissen ist. Siehst du eine bessere Lösung, bringst du sie ein, und wir setzen sie gemeinsam um.

Lernen wir uns kennen

Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne.

Deine Ansprechpersonen:

  • Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen.

  • Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen.

Schreib uns an ----- mit Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätzen dazu, warum diese Stelle zu dir passt.

Dukers GmbH | St. Gallen

data.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

Skydio builds the world’s most advanced autonomous drones used across inspection, public safety, defense, cinematography, and more. Your research won’t languish in a paper: it will fly, shaping how pilots and operators complete real missions in complex environments. Develop and deploy reinforcement learning (and adjacent policy-learning methods) that make Skydio aircraft plan, navigate, and control themselves more intelligently, safely, reliably, and efficiently across our ecosystem: handheld apps, ground control, cloud autonomy services, and fleet workflows.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Navigation & avoidance in the wild: Train policies that adapt online to cluttered 3D scenes (forests, bridges, urban canyons), complementing our stack for robust obstacle avoidance and dynamic goal-seeking.

  • RL-augmented planning: Fuse learned cost shaping / value functions with trajectory optimization for smooth, agile flight with tight safety envelopes and mission constraints.

  • Sim to Real at scale: Build scalable datasets and training loops with Isaac Lab, domain randomization, residual learning, and safety filters; validate on real drones weekly.

  • Human-in-the-loop shared control: Learn assistive policies that blend pilot intent, autonomy priors, and uncertainty-aware behaviors for intuitive control handoffs.

  • Fleet & multi-agent: Explore decentralized coordination for coverage, pursuit, and collaborative mapping with minimal comms.

What makes this internship different:

  • Real hardware cadence: Prototype in sim, then flight test on production-ready aircraft and edge compute. Your work is meant to make a difference in the real world, not just in simulation.

  • Safety-first learning: We pair RL with formal constraints, estimation of uncertainty, and conservative action filters for dependable deployment in human environments.

  • Cross-disciplinary mentorship: Collaborate with perception, mapping, controls, and product teams to close the loop from research to field ops.

What makes you a strong fit:

  • PhD student in Robotics, Machine Learning, Controls, or related field.

  • Strong fundamentals in RL, control theory, and motion planning; comfort with safety/robustness concepts.

  • Proficient in Python (PyTorch/JAX/Ray RLlib) and at least one of C++ or CUDA.

  • Hands-on experience with robotics simulation (Isaac Lab/MuJoCo/PyBullet) and sim2real techniques.

  • Experience training/deploying policies for navigation, manipulation, or locomotion on real robots or autonomous vehicles.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Publications (CoRL, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS).

  • Experience with onboard inference optimization (TensorRT, quantization, sparsity).

  • Familiarity with modern policy learning beyond vanilla RL: diffusion policies, IL/BC, offline RL, model-based RL.

  • Experience with multi-agent RL or distributed training.

Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $47/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Masters, and $70/hr for PhD students*. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. In addition to base salary, Skydio full-time employees are eligible to enroll in our benefit plans and take advantage of a variety of incentives and stipends.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position's location.

data.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the Role:

The core of our system is the computer vision algorithms that allow drones to understand the world around them. You will architect and implement the algorithms that run on every drone powered by Skydio as part of a world class computer vision and deep learning team with researchers who have pushed the state of the art in academia and industry.

As a Research Intern, you will be paired up with one or more members of our core software development team, assuming direct ownership of a project that meaningfully advances the capabilities of our team and products.

If you have a strong foundation in math, theory, and software development and you are interested in directly contributing to the development of the next generation of autonomy algorithms and pushing them into real products, we would love to hear from you.

 

Areas of Responsibility:

  • Core Simulator Architecture: Design, implement, and evolve the foundational architecture of the Skydio Simulator, ensuring it scales across vehicle types, environments, and use cases.

  • Physics and Dynamics: Improve and extend physics models governing vehicle motion, interactions with the environment, and dynamic agents.

  • Sensor and Hardware Simulation: Build high-fidelity simulations of cameras, IMUs, and other onboard components, including timing, noise characteristics, and hardware behavior.

  • Autonomy Stack Integration: Run and validate the full Skydio autonomy stack in simulation, ensuring consistency between simulated and real-world behavior.

  • Feature Development on Top of the Core: Implement simulator capabilities that unlock new workflows for customers and internal autonomy engineers, from training scenarios to advanced testing modes.

  • Performance and Fidelity: Profile, optimize, and improve simulator performance while continuously pushing realism and accuracy.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop core simulator components in C++ and Python, working close to real-time constraints.

  • Collaborate with autonomy, perception, and controls engineers to align simulation behavior with real-world systems.

  • Debug complex interactions between physics, sensors, autonomy logic, and rendering.

  • Help shape the long-term technical direction of the simulator as both a product and an internal platform.

  • Contribute to documentation and shared understanding of how the simulator works internally.

Qualifications:

  • Strong software engineering experience with C++ and Python.

Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

 

About the role

  • What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

  • Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.

  • What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

 

What you'll do

  • Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

  • Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

  • Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

  • Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.

  • Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.

  • Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

  • Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.

  • You have 2+ years of professional Go experience, writing services that run in production, not side projects.

  • You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

  • You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

  • You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

  • You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

  • You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.

  • You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

 

Strong plus

  • Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

  • Experience running multi-tenant systems.

  • Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get

  • Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

  • Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

  • Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

data.description:
Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant

Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite.

Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission.

  • Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance.
  • Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée.
  • Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses.
  • Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation.
  • Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être.

Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience :

  • Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes.
  • Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission.

Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons

Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté.

Ce que nous cherchons

  • Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes.
  • Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas.
  • La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise.
  • De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole.
  • Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients.
  • Français langue maternelle ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier.

Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps

  • Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris.
  • Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe.
  • Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client.

Ce que vous trouverez chez nous

  • Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME.
  • Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année.
  • Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet.
  • Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux.

Comment nous recrutons

Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape.

  • 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions.
  • 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter.
  • 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés.

Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape.

Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection.

We’re looking for experienced ML/AI researchers with a strong publication track record at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) to support an advanced AI research evaluation project. You'll critically assess scientific papers and research outputs generated by autonomous AI research agents, evaluating their technical correctness, scientific novelty, experimental rigor, and overall research quality against the standards of leading ML/AI conferences.

This is a remote, project-based contractor opportunity with flexible working hours.

Tasks

What you'll be doing

  • What you'll be doing

  • Critically evaluate AI-generated ML/AI research papers, assessing their scientific contributions, technical correctness, methodology, experimental design, and conclusions

  • Assess scientific novelty and significance, determining whether proposed approaches represent meaningful advancements over existing state-of-the-art research

  • Evaluate experimental rigor and validity, including baseline comparisons, benchmark selection, evaluation metrics, statistical evidence, and ablation studies

  • Identify methodological flaws, unsupported claims, inconsistencies, or misleading results that undermine the scientific validity of proposed contributions

  • Assess reproducibility and technical soundness, including whether reported findings are sufficiently supported by experimental evidence and, where available, accompanying code and implementation details

  • Review and verify relevant academic literature, identifying overlooked prior work, inaccurate citations, and unsupported novelty claims

  • Evaluate whether AI-generated research meets the scientific standards of top-tier ML/AI conferences, such as NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR

  • Provide structured, evidence-based assessments of research quality, including strengths, weaknesses, critical technical concerns, and overall scientific merit

  • Apply detailed evaluation rubrics consistently, providing clear, well-reasoned justifications for your assessments

The project focuses on evaluating advanced AI-generated scientific research, with an emphasis on technical validity, scientific novelty, experimental rigor, and overall research quality. Your role is to provide expert human judgment on whether the resulting research is scientifically valid, genuinely novel, and of a quality comparable to work accepted at leading ML/AI conferences.

Requirements

You're a strong candidate if you:

  • Have a PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated research expertise

  • Have published at least 3 peer-reviewed research papers at NeurIPS, ICML, and/or ICLR (hard requirement), ideally including first-author or significant research contributions

  • Have substantial hands-on ML/AI research experience, including developing novel methods, designing experiments, analyzing results, and publishing original scientific work

  • Have a strong understanding of scientific methodology and experimental rigor, including appropriate baselines, statistical validity, benchmark design, ablation studies, and reproducibility

  • Can independently assess the novelty, significance, and technical soundness of advanced ML/AI research, identifying both meaningful scientific contributions and fundamental methodological weaknesses

  • Have experience reviewing research papers for top-tier ML/AI conferences or journals, ideally NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR — strongly preferred

  • Are highly familiar with state-of-the-art ML/AI research and can critically assess new methods against existing literature and established benchmarks

  • Are comfortable verifying scientific claims, including reviewing technical arguments, experimental evidence, citations, and, where relevant, code implementations

  • Have strong analytical and scientific writing skills and can articulate nuanced technical judgments through concise, evidence-based feedback

  • Can consistently apply detailed evaluation guidelines and scoring rubrics while exercising independent expert judgment

  • Have exceptional attention to detail, particularly when identifying subtle methodological flaws, unsupported conclusions, or discrepancies between claims and evidence

Benefits

  • Fully remote and flexible — work from anywhere

  • Part-time contractor role with flexible hours

  • Work on the evaluation of cutting-edge autonomous AI systems capable of conducting end-to-end scientific research

  • Apply your research expertise to help assess and advance the scientific capabilities of frontier AI agents

Send us your CV along with a brief note about your research background, areas of expertise, and publication record. Please include links to at least 3 peer-reviewed publications at NeurIPS, ICML, and/or ICLR, as well as any relevant academic peer-review experience.

If applicable, we'd also love to know which ML/AI research areas you're most familiar with and whether you've served as a reviewer, area chair, or in a similar capacity at major research conferences.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

Wil je weten hoe recruitment echt werkt? Bij Eye ga je niet alleen cv's archiveren. Je helpt een groeiend recruitmentteam bouwen aan de manier waarop we mensen aannemen. En als het klikt, willen we je graag laten doorgroeien tot recruiter.

Over Eye

Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We groeien hard, dus er is veel te bouwen en veel te leren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies

  • Je screent sollicitaties voor onze junior functies, waarvan veel in het Nederlands

  • Je maakt van recruitmentdata heldere rapportages waar het team en managers echt iets aan hebben

  • Je verbetert hoe we ons ATS gebruiken en houdt de data op orde

  • Je brengt structuur in onze recruitmentkennis, te beginnen met alle vacatureteksten op één plek

  • Je zorgt dat sollicitatiegesprekken soepel verlopen: plannen, afstemmen en contact met kandidaten

  • Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen

De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels

  • Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn

  • Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel

  • Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit

  • Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen

Mooi meegenomen

  • Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden

  • Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS

Wat krijg je?

  • Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert

  • Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter

  • Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken

  • Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation"

Over Eye Security

Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden.

We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers.

Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst.

Kleine noot: in de Engelse en Nederlandse vacature in het document staat “ruim 190 collega’s”, wat recentere vacatures van Eye ook noemen. Kijk even welk getal je wilt aanhouden, zodat beide versies hetzelfde zeggen.

About the role.

We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant.

When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers.



How you embrace curiosity daily.

  • Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities.

  • Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability.

  • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams.

Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties

Ben jij een ervaren installatietechnicus die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol? Of geef je al leiding aan monteurs en wil je meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je zorgt dat werkzaamheden goed worden voorbereid, projecten volgens planning verlopen en jouw collega's hun werk optimaal kunnen uitvoeren. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers. Daarbij houd je overzicht, denk je mee over technische oplossingen en zorg je voor een prettige samenwerking.

Wat we je bieden

Bij Campus Installatietechniek krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, jouw team verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan mooie installatieprojecten. Daar staat natuurlijk iets tegenover:

  • Moderne middelen en gereedschappen om je werk goed uit te voeren;

Wat je gaat doen

Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:
